purpose: Single machine-readable migration ledger for every canonical Academy cast sprite across current delivery and audited older worktrees.

truthPolicy.matrixTarget: Every character requires three angles by seven expressions. A file is never inferred from a brief.
truthPolicy.approval: Generation and physical presence do not imply runtime approval.
truthPolicy.variedPoses: Each character keeps the unique base pose from SPRITE-BATCH-MANIFEST.json; pose cloning is forbidden.
truthPolicy.deprecatedArt: Flat, wrong-style, and rejected-likeness assets are reference-only audit evidence and must not be learner-facing.
